process.title: A serious process, human support.
process.intro: Trusting someone with your home or your business takes confidence. Here, simply, how we work.

steps.title: You write to us
steps.description: A WhatsApp message or a call: you describe your need, your city and your schedule.

steps.title: We screen
steps.description: We look for qualified profiles that genuinely match your need.

steps.title: We verify
steps.description: We verify the shortlisted profiles before presenting them to you.

steps.title: We connect you
steps.description: Introduction, then support: we stay available for what comes next.

process.noteStrong: Rates and availability are confirmed directly during the conversation
process.noteRest: , based on your city, your schedule and the level of responsibility expected.

pricing.title: Clear landmarks to prepare your request.
pricing.intro: Here is the rate card for our main home services. It gives an order of magnitude; the rate for your situation is confirmed directly during the conversation. Indicative amounts in Moroccan dirhams (MAD / DH).
pricing.disclaimer: Rates are indicative and vary with the city, duration, schedule and level of responsibility.

contact.title: Let's talk about your need.
contact.intro: The simplest way: write to us on WhatsApp. We reply, ask the right questions, then present the right profile.
contact.chatVisitor: Hello Yallah Services, I'd like to discuss my need. I am looking for a nanny in Casablanca.
contact.chatCompany1: Hello 👋 Thank you for your message. Could you specify your schedule and the frequency you want?
contact.chatCompany2: Perfect. We come back to you within 24h with verified profiles, suited to your need.
contact.chatDisclaimer: Example conversation. Your message then opens in WhatsApp: you can edit it before sending.
